method_names_textual_inventory_only: B1 actual HTTP/2 batching can return more than the requested 32 KiB
B2 paced no-length HTTP/2 input admits exactly the application byte cap
B3 a sent cap-plus-one input is refused and its halted stream is disposed
D1 nonprogress controls preserve the package public read deadline
D2 Mixer refuses the timed public empty-more result as no_progress

manual_review.adapter: same stream owner, real Bandit.Adapter, faithful two-method observer and newest-state unwrap before response
manual_review.B1: 32 tiny prefix frames plus legal bounded tail, correlated PING fence and mandatory measured return above requested length
manual_review.B2: 32 paced exact-target reads, terminal payload END_STREAM, exact bytes/signature and finite admission
manual_review.B3: 31 paced tranches plus reserved-credit single final 32769-byte send; rejects too_large without extra-byte-consumption claim
manual_review.D1_D2: separate SETTINGS/WINDOW_UPDATE processing witnesses before fixed empty-more return; Mixer no_progress checked separately
manual_review.frame_flow: passive fixed-header/payload parser, strict selected frames/refusals, both credits updated and all frame/input/read/event bounds retained
manual_review.cleanup: temporary owned ExUnit listener, public shutdown100ms/child400ms, correlated disposal and recorded socket/stream/connection/query/listener closure; failure poisons next admission
manual_review.CI: normal test/support compilation and *_test.exs discovery, no workflow change; official Mix source explains .app metadata load under --no-start

deadline_scope: 25s shared monotonic admission/cooperative waits; listener startup and OS calls are not hard preempted. 26s ExUnit guard is per-test failure containment, not hard cumulative module wall time.
network_source_reads: 7 official Elixir1.20.4 GitHub file GETs solely to resolve --no-start app loading; no runtime/network probe
receipt_acceptance: Require delivered source/version, successful format/compile/full test outcome and exactly seven passing case receipts with cleanup; never accept a receipt alone if the enclosing test or suite fails.
scope: Finite package read/batching and Mixer capture admission only; no hard arbitrary read cancellation, exhaustive advisory/memory/backpressure/provider/production/native/device/GA acceptance.
